flourishes.text: under a clear blue sky
beneath overcast skies
under a blood-orange sunset
in the dead of night
in the pale light of early morning
under a bright midday sun
beneath driving rain and storm-lit skies
beneath lightning-cracked storm clouds
by lamplight, the room close and warm
in the hush of a candlelit room
under the white hum of fluorescent light
under a wide cloudless sky
beneath a sky scrubbed clean and blue
beneath a flat grey sky
under skies the color of ash
beneath a sky bruised and heavy with rain
under gusting wind and stinging spray
in the long light of late afternoon
beneath a sky streaked with the last color of dusk
under the sterile glow of overhead panels
in the dim hum of enclosed, artificial light
as the first fat drops start to land
lightning flickering low on the horizon
wind driving the rain in long sideways strokes
with a hard rain still coming down
with the sun high and the shadows short
the sky a hard blue from edge to edge
as the morning haze burns away
heat shimmer rising off the flat ground
cloud shadows dragging across the ground
with the sky a flat sheet of grey
as the light goes flat and pewter
as the afternoon light goes long
the first stars just showing
in the flat silver light before sunrise
dust hanging in the last of the light
